body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). `packages/skill-rot/test/frontmatter-preserve.test.mjs` and `packages/skill-rot/test/skill-rot.test.mjs` manually invoke `mkdtempSync` and guard removals in 37 `try/finally` blocks (or leak temporary directories without cleanup), and are allowlisted in `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`. With `@adlc/core/test-kit` (`tmp`), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via `t.after` when passed the test context `t`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/skill-rot/test/frontmatter-preserve.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept the `t` parameter.
   - Replace `mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'skill-rot-write-'))` with `tmp(t, 'skill-rot-write-')`.
2. In `packages/skill-rot/test/skill-rot.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations using temp directories to accept the `t` parameter.
   - Replace `makeTempDir()` with `tmp(t, 'skill-rot-test-')`.
   - Remove all `try { ... } finally { cleanup(tmp); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
   - Delete the local `function makeTempDir()` and `function cleanup(dir)` helpers.
3. In `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`:
   - Remove `'packages/skill-rot/test/frontmatter-preserve.test.mjs'` and `'packages/skill-rot/test/skill-rot.test.mjs'` from the `ALLOWLIST` set.
4. Verification:
   - `npm test -w packages/skill-rot` exits 0 with all 76 tests passing.
   - `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
   - `grep -c 'finally' packages/skill-rot/test/frontmatter-preserve.test.mjs packages/skill-rot/test/skill-rot.test.mjs` outputs 0 and 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'finally' packages/skill-rot/test/frontmatter-preserve.test.mjs packages/skill-rot/test/skill-rot.test.mjs` reports 0 and 0.
- AC2 Neither test file defines a local `makeTempDir` or `cleanup` helper.
- AC3 `grep -E 'packages/skill-rot/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` returns nothing.
- AC4 `npm test -w packages/skill-rot` exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC5 `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC6 `adlc rails-guard` exits 0.
title: refactor(skill-rot): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 37 try/finally blocks in skill-rot tests
